svg.title: Zinoxx. Samir Mercado, co-founder and lead engineer at ViVia Technologies, student at 42 Lisboa.
svg.desc: An orbital map of my repositories: the closer a body is to the core, the more recently I pushed to it. The ring around the core is the last year of contributions, one bar a week. Redrawn every night.
